Key features will include visual representations of metrics, alerts for deployment issues, and a user-friendly interface that promotes accessibility for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. By implementing this dashboard, teams will be empowered to identify bottlenecks, streamline workflows, and foster a culture of transparency and accountability within their DevOps practices.
